svg.title: Checklist of FDA structure function claim criteria
svg.desc: Educational summary; not legal clearance for a SKU.
svg.text: Structure/function claim criteria as an operator checklist
Ten criteria for structure/function claims (2000 rule) — checklist, not permission
☐ Describes role of nutrient/dietary ingredient in structure or function of the body
☐ Describes general well-being from consumption of a nutrient/dietary ingredient
☐ Describes a benefit related to a classical nutrient deficiency (with prevalence disclosure)
☐ Does not claim to diagnose, mitigate, treat, cure, or prevent disease
☐ Truthful and not misleading · substantiated · 101.93 disclaimer present
See 21 CFR 101.93 and piece 24 — fictional summary for audit prep
Original typeset diagram · educational only · not a photograph of a real SKU label
